title: Grilled Eggplant Shawarma
description: A delicious Middle Eastern-inspired vegetarian dish featuring grilled eggplant served in a crispy flatbread with zesty tahini sauce. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Season eggplant slices with salt and pepper.
Grill eggplant slices for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly charred.
Warm flatbread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven at 350°F (180°C) for 5 minutes.
Spread 1-2 tablespoons of zesty tahini sauce on each flatbread.
Add any additional toppings you like, such as sliced veggies or pickled turnips.
Optional: Top with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro for extra flavor and color.
